Three.js r180 (0.180.0), MIT.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
The two minified ES modules and license were retrieved from the official npm three package.
GLTFLoader.js and BufferGeometryUtils.js in addons/ are from the official r180 source; their bare three imports point to the local matching module. They load the separately credited CC0 Quaternius character.
Used for the original SHL phone scene and the FoG scene. No tracking or runtime CDN requests.
